parts.name: Body Interior
parts.Basic_description: The body interior of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel, forming the main washing chamber that holds racks and spray arms.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a sealed environment for washing dishes, resists corrosion, and supports internal components like racks and sprayers.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: The door of the dishwasher is a hinged panel made of stainless steel with an integrated handle and insulation layer.
parts.Functional_description: It seals the washing chamber during operation and provides access for loading and unloading dishes.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a lower hinge, allowing it to open and close smoothly.

parts.name: Side Controls
parts.Basic_description: The side controls are made of durable plastic and include buttons or a touch panel for user input.
parts.Functional_description: They allow the user to select washing modes, start or stop cycles, and adjust settings.
parts.Movement_description: They are fixed in place but include movable or touch-sensitive components for user interaction.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the structural outer shell of the dishwasher, made of steel for rigidity and support.
parts.Functional_description: It supports all internal components and provides stability to the entire appliance.
parts.Movement_description: It is a static part that does not move during operation.
